The Momcozy Breast Milk Cooler keeps your milk fresh for over 24 hours with 360° surround cooling. Simply freeze the cooling tube, place it in the cooler, and you’re ready to go. The inner bottles are easy to clean with the Momcozy bottle washer, and the cooler’s compact design makes it travel-friendly.
